articles.summary: Singapore, 13 November 2026 BW LPG Limited (“BW LPG” or the “Company”, OSE ticker code: “BWLPG.OL”, NYSE ticker code: “BWLP”) is pleased to announce the sale of the 2015-built BW Mistral, acquired in the 2024 Avance Gas transaction. The sale of BW Mistral is expected to generate a net book gain of approximately US$37 million…
articles.title: BW LPG Limited announces sale of BW Mistral
